scope: Local FastAPI route registration. No server requests, browser execution, permission checks or provider parity are claimed.
limitations: Client-side menus, routes, dialogs and permission-dependent states still require live browser enumeration.
Frontend candidates use path, response type, tags and handler module hints; native API routes supporting browser actions need separate mapping.
Administrative and Scenario-export routes are excluded from provider frontend candidates.
Every route check remains pending; registration does not establish functional behavior or coverage.
